title: Khatti Meethi Binis ki Phali (Sweet and Sour Green Beans)

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: A sweet-sour green bean side for any meat dish, or with daal and rice or bread.

steps.action: Heat in a large frying pan over high, 2 min:

items: 1 tsp yellow or brown mustard seeds

steps.action: Add and fry 2 min, stirring often:
items: 1 large onion (12 oz / 340 g), finely chopped

steps.action: Add and fry 1 min, stirring often:
Add; reduce to medium-high (7/10), stir, cover, and cook 10 min:
items: 1 lb green beans (450 g), trimmed, in 1 in (2.5 cm) lengths

steps.action: Uncover; cook on high, stirring, about 3 min, until most of the water is gone.
